tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 387)༄༅/lo tog rgyas phyir char dbab pa'i 'don 'grigs 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/mu rub btsad po bud+dha dwi pa dang*/
387)༄༅/lo tog rgyas phyir char dbab pa'i 'don 'grigs 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/mu rub btsad po bud+dha dwi pa dang*/

tei:div.tei:p: lo tog rgyas phyir char dbab pa'i 'don 'grigs 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ mu rub btsad po bud+dha dwi pa dang*/ khye'u chung lo tsā bdud 'dul gling pa dang*// shud pu dpal seng mi 'gyur rdo rje sogs// rtsod bral pad+ma'i rgyal tshab rnams la bsngags// spyan ras gzigs dbang karma chags med zhabs// rgyal ba byang chub kun bzang shes rab sogs// mchog thun gser gyi rgyan gyis legs spras pa'i// grub brnyes rig 'dzin rgya mtsho phyag gi gnas// gangs can grub pa'i 'byung gnas che// rgyal dbang dpal yul ba zhes pa'i// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag gzhes ltar// char 'bebs 'don 'grigs gsal bar 'god/ 'di la gnyis/ char sgrub pa dang*/ char 'bebs dngos las/ dang po rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bka' srol char slong ba'i cho ga 'byung ba dbang sgyur kun 'gengs rgya mtsho ltar char bsgrub bya ba'i tshul 388) ni/ chos spyod rnams zin nas/ hrīḥsngon= spos phyung*/ kyai 'das gnyis/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun rnams dang*/ na mo:dkon mchog gsum dang= lan gsum/ ka dag klong nas= mchod pa sna bdun 'dod yon lnga: zhes kha bsgyur kyang chog rin chen snod du= rtsa gsum las byang nang*/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje zhe ba sku mdog sngo skya= sogs sbyar nas bstod bshags yan grub pa dang*/ rang gi thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ oṃ bho dhi satwa badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐: zhes bzlas pa stong phrag tsam song nas/ ar+ghaṃ= sogs kyis mchod/ lcang lo can gyi= sogs kyis bstod/ mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li= sogs kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā ba= sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dal mi dmigs pa stong gsum gyi 'jig rten= sogs gzhung ltar/ a ti pu ho/ bar dang*/ 'don rta dang bcas/ hūm̐/ klu rgyal dga' bo= 389) sogs nas/

ar+ghaṃ pad+yaṃ= yan/ de nas sngags ring*/ oṃ bho dhi satwa= sogs nas/ sid+dhi bam̐ swā hā/ yan sbrel ma stong phrag gcig ma 'gro bar bskyal/ 'dzam bu gling du nam dgos pa'i= sogs lan gcig brjod/ sngags thung*/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi= sogs nas/ bha ri sha ya swā hāḥ bar/ khri tsho gcig tshar nges pa bya/ thun mthar/ mdun du bsgoms pa'i klu thams cad char rdzas la thim par bsgom/ thun mtshams su cha snyom ci tshar/ bsang log bris sogs ci 'grub/ sprin mdo rgyas bsdus rnams tshar grangs/ mi 'gyur lhun po= sogs bkra shis/ phyogs dus rgyal ba sogs bsngo smon byas te snga thun grol/ phyi thun la/ hrīḥsngon= spos phyung*/ bzang spyod yan bdun/ na mo:dkon mchog gsum dang= lan gsum/ ka dag klong nas= gnam sa= mchod pa= zad med= rang nyid phyag na rdo rje zhi ba= 390) sogs nas/ gcig tu bskyed/ a mri ta= swa bhā ba= stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dal mi dmigs= sogs nas nar 'gros/ sngags ring stong*/ 'dod gsol gcig sngags thung khri tshar nas/ rnga brdung nas rlung mnan ni/ hūm̐/ rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su/ gur drag rta mgrin gsang bdag go cha'i lha// yi dam khro bo'i sku ru gsal bar gyur/ zhes dang*/ brub khung gru gsum= sogs nas/ na mo:dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum/ sogs 'gugs thung tshar brgya/ na mo/ drin chen= tshar gsum/ bden chung dgu/ rtsa rgyud gsum/ gtor 'bul/ phur thun tshams bskul/ 'o/ skyabs gnas= sogs tshar gsum/ oṃ bha ya ye= sogs tshar brgya/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha= sogs tshar brgya/ rlung ya tshe= sogs tshar brgya/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru= sogs tshar brgya/ badz+ra pā ṇi= sogs tshar gsum/ rlung lha 'dre ngan= sogs dang*/ sngags/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha raṣ+ṭha= sogs tshar brgya/ oṃ char ya chur ya ba yu s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ rkyang pa stong phrag gcig 391) bro mnan/ bgegs rigs stong phrag= sogs shis brjod bya/ nub mo lus dkyil gur drag nas/

gtor bsngos yongs rdzogs gsungs/ de'i 'gres kyi nyi ma bdun sogs la char sgrub mdzad do/ gnyis pa char slong dngos bya ba la/ 'di nyid kho na ltar bya ba dang*/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i bla ma dngos 'dus char 'bebs bdud rtsi bum chung mkhas grub chags med rin po che'i bka' srol ltar bya ba dang*/ rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje'i lugs kyi char 'bebs bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho grub brnyes karma 'gyur med kyi yig cha ltar bya tshul gsum/ dang po rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bka' srol ltar bya ba'i tshul gyi 'don 'grigs ni/ gang du 'gro sa gsang nas der zil gnon 'phen pa ni/ rang nyid yi dam gang yin bskyed rim gsal ba'i thugs ka nas rdo rje= sogs nas/ bskor bar bsam/ bar/ de nas lam du zhugs nas/ ri'am chu mig mthong ba na/ rkang gling lan gsum 'bud pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal phyag na rdo rje= sogs nas/ med par bsam/ de nas char slong gi sar sleb nas/ mtshams bzhir tho bzhi brtsegs pa'i 'og tu gong gsal ltar rlung mnan lan 392) bzhi bya/ tho bzhi'i sked par sats+tsha dkar sngo= sogs nas/ gur khang lta bur gyur/ chu mgo'i sngas su song la snyan gsan/ 'o/ yul phyogs= sogs nas/ ma 'da' zhig bar dang*/ chu dar 'dzugs/ gnam sa gta' sdom/ klu khang bca'/ chu mig tu dkar rta bkram la/ na mo gu ru bud+dha= sogs nas/ thob par gyur/ yan brjod/ skad gcig gis khro bo'i bskyed rim= sogs nas/ sum bha ni= yan des sngon 'gro song*/ ༈ dngos gzhi la/ hrīḥsngon= tshul khrims dri ldan/ kyai 'das/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma/ na mo:dkon mchog gsum dang= lan gsum/ ka dag klong nas= gnam sa= mchod pa= zad med= rang nyid bstan pa'i bdag po ni/ sogs nas/ seng khrir bzhugs/ bar dang*/ gong gi klu sgrub ltar/ badz+ra a mri ta= swa bha ba= stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dal mi dmigs pa las= sogs nas/ a ti pu ho/

bar dang*/ 'og gi hūm̐/ dga' bo mi mgon= sogs nas/ tsa le hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bar dang*/ gong ga ི hūm̐/ klu rgyal dga' bo= sogs nas/ ar+ghaṃ= sogs bar/ 'og gi kyai/ klu chen klu mo= sogs nas/ 393) bzod par gsol/ bar dang*/ sa 'og= sogs/ oṃ gu ru na ma= sogs/ sprin sdud sngags lnga brgya tsam bzla/ rang gi tshe rabs= sogs nas/ oṃ mu ne= sogs char sngags khri tsam las mi nyung bar bzlas/ 'o/ rgyal po chen po= sogs nas/ bsal du gsol lo/ bar dang cha snyom gsum/ bsang rgyal brngan/ 'khor 'das mchod pa/ dam sri glud mdos/ rgyal gsol/ sde brgyad khengs mdos/ brtan ma spyi mdos/ sprin mdo/ ri khrus/ rlung mnan gzhung gsal rgyab chos rnams ci 'grub bya/ bkra shis bsngo smon sogs byas te thun grol/ phyi thun dgongs thun rnams de ltar/ nyin gnyis pa la/ hrīḥsngon= yan lag bdun pa/ maṇ+ḍal/ na mo:dkon mchog gsum= ka dag klong nas= gong gi klu sgrub bdag bskyed/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje zhi ba= sogs nas/ gcig tu bskyed/ a mri ta/ swa bhā ba= stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dal mi dmigs= sogs nas/ phyag 'tshal rjes/ 'og gi klu the'u bkar/ gong gi mchod pa/ 'og gi sos 'bul/ sprin sdud sngags stong tsam/ sdug bsngal kun dang bral 394)bar bsam/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ 'og ga ི rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las= sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra da ru= sogs char sngags khri tsam/ gong gi 'o/ rgyal po chen po= sogs nas/ bsal du gsol/ bsang*/ cha gsum sogs sngar ltar/ bkra shis bsngo smon gyis mtha' bsdu ba/ thun du byed la 'dra/ ༈ nyin gsum pa la/ bde sdug gtong len yan nyin gnyis pa ltar la/ 'og gi rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ bla ma yi dam= sogs nas/ char khri tsho re tsam/ 'o/ rgyal po chen po= yan sngar ltar/ ༈ nyin bzhi pa la/ hrīḥsngon= yan bdun/ maṇ+ḍal/ na mo:dkon mchog= ka dag= zil gnon skabs kyi/ rang nyid skad cig gi dpal phyag na rdo rje shin tu khros pa=

sogs nas/ klu thams cad 'gro dbang med par bsam/ mdun bskyed man chod nyin snga ma rnams ltar la/ sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar bsam/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ 'og gi rang gi spyi bo'i bya khyung gis klu rnams= sogs nas/ char sngags khri tsam bzlas/ mthar/ gong ga ི na mo/ bla ma dam pa= sogs nas/ bsal du gsol/ bar dang*/ 'og ga ི 'o/ klu 395)khyed rnams la= sogs nas/ phog cig bar/ cha gsum bsang sogs sngar ltar/ ༈ nyin lnga pa la/ gtong len dmigs pa yan nyin bzhi pa ltar la/ 'og gi bsrung bya thams cad kyi= sogs nas/ ni na ga= thog srung lnga brgya tsam/ stong gsum 'di= sogs nas/ na ga dza mu= sogs lnga brgya tsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas= sogs/ char sngags khri tsho tsam/ mthar/ na mo/ bla ma dam pa= sogs nas/ bsal du gsol/ bar dang*/ 'og gi gal te char mi bab= sogs nas/ phob cig gzhan sngar ltar/ ༈ nyin drug pa la/ sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar bsam/ yan nyin bzhi pa ltar/ sbal gzugs la/ na mo/ bslu med dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum// gsang bdag khyung dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i mthus// stong gsum khams kyi klu gnyan sa bdag tshogs// thams cad sbal pa 'di la myur du khug dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa lta bu tshar brgya/ oṃ nā ga ru ḍā= sogs/ khri tshar/ na mo/ bla ma dam pa= sogs nas/ bsal du gsol/ bar/ gzhan nyin snga ma rnams ltar/ ༈ nyin bdun bar/ bde sdug gtong len yan sngar ltar la/ rang bya khyung du= sogs/ oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍā= sogs/ 396) khri tshar/ na mo/ bla ma dam pa man= sngar ltar/ yang gces man ngag rnams gseb tshags su btang*/ ༈ char babs nas rjes chog ni/ hrīḥsngon= yan bdun/ maṇ+ḍal/ na mo:dkon mchog= ka dag klong nas= rang nyid bstan pa'i bdag po= mdun skyed/ klu the'u bkar/ mchod pa/ sob 'bul/ bstod pa/ char rgyun/ myur du phob/ bar dang*/ 'og gi yeshes kyi bdud rtsi'i= sogs/ ru ru phu ru= ci mang*/ klu'i nad dang= sogs/ bum pa bh+rum̐ las= sogs nas/ spyan drangs la bstim/

gong gi mchod pa/ hūm̐/ klu rgyal dga' bo= sogs dang*/ kyai/ klu chen klu mo= sogs/ gnas gyur cig bar dang*/ bshags pa/ hūm̐/ klu rgyal dga' bo= sogs/ bzod par gsol/ bar/ yig rgya/ durga= kaṃ ka= rnams ci mang brjod/ gshegs gsol/ hūm̐/ klu rgyal dga' bo= sogs/ gats+tsha= bar dang*/ tho la dkar gtor bzhi 'phul la/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i= sogs dang*/ rlung lha'i mnan pa bton la/ ji ltar bltams pa= sogs khrus dang*/ ma snyed yongs su= sogs bshags pa/ ar+ghaṃ= rlung ste= badz+ra muḥ mi 'gyur lhun po= sogs shis brjod/ phyogs dus rgyal ba= sogs dang*/ bdag gzhan rnams kyi= sogs smon lam btab/ de nas tshur ldog pa'i lam khar/ tho brtsigs la/ khrom zhes brjod pas tho de= sogs/ sleb par bsam/ bar brjod 397) pas grub bo/ gnyis pa dgongs 'dus char chog bdud rtsi bum chung ltar bya ba'i 'don 'grigs ni/ 'gro khar zil gnon ni/ hūm̐:rang nyid skad cig yi dam= sogs nas/ sngags lan bdun brjod nas 'gro/ der sleb nas rdo tho bcu byas nas/ hūm̐: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs= sogs brjod/ klu khang brtsig pa sogs gzhung gsal ltar bya/ dngos gzhi ni/ hrīḥsngon= yan lag bcu pa/ maṇ+ḍal/ na mo:dkon mchog ka dag= rin chen snod du= rtsa gsum las byang nang mtshan brgyad cig dril lta bu sbyar nas/ bsnyen bstod bcas/ gzhung ga ི rang gi thugs las 'od zer= sogs nas/ 'gugs pa brgya tshar/ hūm̐/ phyi rol gling bzhi= sogs dang*/ snyan gsan/ kyai/ nyon cig stong gsum= lan gsum/ skyabs sems/ bcom ldan rnam snang snying po'i= sogs nas/ bdag skyed/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sogs/ bum skyed/ mdun gyi bum pa= sogs nas/ char phob cig bar dang*/ dgongs 'dus rtsa sngags sum brgya tsam/ bum lha rigs gsum= sogs/ rigs gsum bsnyen pa brgya re/ mdun skyed/ swa bhā ba= stong pa'i ngang las= sogs nas/ skye bar gyur/ oṃ nā ga sogs char sngags khri tsam/ bum lha rigs gsum=

sogs/ sngags sbrel ma brgya tsam/ de nas cha snyom/ cha gsum/ 398) bsang*/ gtor chog rigs ci nus sbyar/ de yan thun gnyis gsum dang*/ nyin phyed rlung gnon ni/ rang nyid drag po= sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ phyogs bzhi= sogs nas/ 'gugs pa brgya tshar/ gtor 'bul/ rlung lha 'dre ngan= sogs dang*/ sngags stong tshar/ char ya= rkyang pa stong tsho ya zung*/ sprin sdud ni/ hūm̐/ rang nyid gsang bdag= sogs dang*/ a kra ka ro= stong phrag gcig klu thams cad kyi= sogs nas/ mdzod cig phyi dro zhi drag phyed ma ni/ hūm̐/ rang nyid ngo bo rang gi= sogs nas/ 'gugs pa nyer gcig tsam/ hūm̐/ sbal pa= sogs nas/ 'bebs par gyur/ bar/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi= sogs/ sngags 'di stong phrag gnyis gsum bzlas/ hūm̐ las phur pa= sogs dang*/ gong gi sngags lan gsum tsam/ zhi drag phyed ma 'di shin tu zab pas de ltar thun ci mang dang*/ dgongs ka drag 'bod ni/ hūm̐/ rang nyid ngo bo yi dam= sogs nas/ sngags lnga brgya tsam/ nub mo rang gi rgyun gyi yi dam chos skyong gtor 399) chog rnams dang*/ lus sbyin sogs bya'o/ de kho nas nyin du dgos la bya ba las shin tu drag 'bod gnad 'bebs rigs rnams shes pa tsam lag tu len na rgyal ba byang chub sems dpa'i tshul dang 'gal bar gyur na btang snyoms su bzhag gal srid snying rje chen pos gzhan don du 'gyur na lag tu blang dgos pa'i tshul ni/ dgong mo drag 'bod kyi sngags bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ hūm̐/ rang nyid phyag rdor= sogs nas/ khyab par gyur/ zhes pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ drag 'bod sngags bzla ba'am yang na chu mig gzhan zhig tu song nas/ hūm̐/ rang nyid ngo bo yi dam= sogs nas/ 'gugs pa nyer gcig oṃ nā ga gru= sogs sngags lnga brgya tsam dang*/ skabs thams cad du thog srung dmigs pa/ spyi bor gser gyi= sogs dang*/ ni na ga= sogs sngags ci 'grub bzlas pas/ bla ma dgongs 'dus 'di byin rlabs shin tu che bas 'dis char mi 'bab pa mi srid nges pa yin na yang*/

hūm̐/ rang nyid ngo bo= 400) sogs nas/ 'gugs pa nyer gcig tsam/ char sngags mgo mjug ldog pa zhag gcig bzlas pas drag char myur du 'bab nges so/ ༈ rjes chog ni/ da dung yun ring 'bab dgos na zhi 'bod rkyang pa nyin kha shas byas nas/ hrīḥ rang nyid skad cig= sogs nas ma ṇi brgya/ bde sdug gtong len/ chos sbyin dang*/ klu gtor ci 'grub dang*/ bsang rgyas bsdus gang rung*/ bh+rūm̐ḥbh+rūm̐ las= sogs nas gtang rag nyes bshags/ gter sbas/ mchod bstod/ rlung lha gshegs/ bsngo smon/ bdag bskyed bsdu/ 'gro ran pa na/

hūm̐/ rang nyid stong pa'i= sogs dang*/ lam khar tho la/ khroṃ las= sogs btang bas legs par grub bo/ gsum pa bdud 'dul char chog bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho'i 'don 'grigs ni/ 'gro kha'i zil gnon dmigs pa/ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i= sogs dang*/ chu mig 401) mthong nas rkang dung 'bud pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ rang skad gcig gis 'phags pa= sogs dang*/ sleb nas phyi tho bzhi la/ hūm̐/ ri rab chen po'i= sogs brjod/ bar tho bcu la/ hūm̐/ rang nyid skad gcig dran rdzogs= sogs dang*/ rnam 'joms dme brtsegs sogs kyis khrus bya/ chu mig rtsar snyan gsan/ 'o/ yul phyogs= sogs dang*/ nang tho bzhir/ hūm̐/ rang nyid shar phyogs= sogs dang*/ rlung mnan rdo rje'i 'ching zhags ltar/ hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni dpal chen= sogs nas/ 'gugs pa ring mo tshar gsum/ thung ba brgya/ bden chung dgu/ rtsa rgyud gsum/ badz+ra pa ṇi= gsum/ hūm̐/ dpal chen= sogs nas/ sngags ring brgya/ rlung lha= sogs sngags brgya/ bro mnan/ bkra shis bcas/ sats+tsha bzhi la/ a ka ro= hūm̐ hrīḥ rgyal ba'i bka' nyan= sogs dang*/ klu khang dang gzhi bca'/ dkar rta bkram pa/ rang nyid bstan pa'i= sogs/ gnam sa rta bsdoms/ bcas 402) zin nas/ ༈ dngos gzhi la/ hrīḥsngon= bdud 'dul gro lod dam/ yang na dgongs 'dus kyai 'das/ maṇ+ḍal/ cha snyoms gsum/ na mo:dkon mchog= ka dag= rin chen snod du= mthar/ bdag sgrub pa po= sogs/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bar/ rtsa gsum las byang nang gur drag gsang sgrub lta bu sbyar la/ bsnyen bstod mthar/ rang gi thugs ka= sogs nas/ 'gugs pa brgya/ hūm̐/ phyi rol= sogs nas/ mchod rlab/ bdag skyed ma ṇi stong*/ mchod bstod/ bum bskyed/ dgongs 'dus bsnyen pa brgya/ bum lha bcom ldan= sngags sum brgya re/ klu bum bskyed pa nas/ skye bar gyur= yan sngags ring stong cig bum lha bcom ldan= sogs dang*/ sngags stong ngam brgya/ 'dod gsol/ oṃ sarba= sogs/ klu bsang klu gtor ci 'grub bya/

nyin phyed rlung mnan gong ltar dang*/ sngags gong 'og gsum/ ci nus bzlas/ sprin sdud gzhung gi hūm̐/ rang nyid 'phags pa= sogs dang*/ sngags stong*/ 403) 'brug bskul dmigs pa dang*/ sngags sum brgya/ 'o/ klu rgyal= sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ rang nyid yi dam= sogs dang*/ sngags brgya/ ho/ gsang bdag= sogs nas/ sngags ring brgya/ 'o/ 'phags pa= sogs gong ltar/ bdud mgon bskul/ sngags brgya/ 'o/ dpal ldan= sogs/ gong ltar dang*/ hūm̐/ rang nyid ngo bo= sogs nas/ 'gugs pa gsum/ sngags ring stong*/ ho/ khro rgyal= sogs gong ltar dang*/ gal te= sogs dang*/ dgong mo drag 'bod/ hūm̐/ ngo bo rang nyid= sogs nas/ sngags stong*/ hūm̐/ rang nyid seng sgra'i= sogs nas/ sngags sum brgya tsam/ gtor bsngo lus sbyin rnams bya/ de lta bus nyin du dgos bya/ gnad 'bebs dgos na nye logs chu mig rtsar/ hūm̐/ rang nyid ngo bo= sogs/ 'gugs pa nyer cig sngags ring brgya/ skabs su thog srung gzab/ hūm̐/ rang nyid= sogs nas/ sngags nyin zhag gcig bzla/ rjes chog hrīḥrang nyid skad cig= maṇi brgya/ gtong len/ chos sbyin/ klu bsang rgyas bsdus gang rigs/ bh+rūm̐ las= 404) sogs/ gtor 'bul/ 'khrugs bsdum/ gter sba/ dug phyung*/ byad bkrol/ sman gtor/ dkar gtor 'bul ba/ phrin bcol/ klu la smin byed/ rjes chog mchod bstod/ gshegs gsol/ tho bkrol rnam bzhi/ rlung mnan bton/ rgab 'dre phyir mnan/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis brjod/ nyer bsdu/ lhar ldang*/ phyir lam bcad pa rnams kyis legs par grub bo/ gzhan smin lugs klu gtor gdengs can 'dod 'jo ltar mdzad srol sngar rje gong ma rnams kyi dus nas yod kyang gzhan du gsal/ khyim du char 'bod dgos tshe yum ka'i las tshogs bcu gnyis pa dang*/ tshe ring ma'i char 'bebs sbrags pa'i 'don 'grigs grub chen kun bzang gzhan phan gyi yig cha ltar byas na char 'baibs kun las kyang*/ 'di nyid zab ces bka' drin mnyam med rje rin po che o rgyan mdo sngags chos kyi nyi ma dpal bzang po phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde mchog gi zhal lung

405) dri ma med pa'o// de ltar mkhas pa'i mchog gyur rong klong gnyis// grub pa'i dbang phyug so zur gnubs gsum gyi// brgyud pa 'dzin la nga 'dra med ces par// dus kyi mthar yang bos pa byed pa bzhin/ snga 'gyur brgyud pa 'dzin pa phal cher yang*// man ngag dum rer rang lugs rtsis 'dzin nas/ khyab bdag kun bzang shes rab mchog lta bu// bka' gter rgya mtsho hub kyis btung ba dka'/ khyod kyi snga 'gyur bka' gter rgya mtsho'i 'jing*// man ngag snying tig nor bu'i gram bu brdal// mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa lhag ma lus// yongs rdzogs 'dzin la dpal yul ba zhes grags// gzhan du pad+ma'i rjes 'jug rloms pa phal// pad+ma'i chos la nga khyod phyogs bzung nas// rgya mtsho'i 'gram du skom grir shi ba phal// bsam zhing bsam zhing snying nas 406) mchi ma bku// a pha'i kha phor gtsang zhen ma rtsod par/ khyab bdag kun bzang shes rab ji bzhin du// snga 'gyur bstan pa yongs rdzogs la zhugs dang*// kun bzang shes rab gral mtha' zin par 'gyur// dpal yul ba yi slob 'bangs tha shal ba/ pad+ma kun bzang bstan 'dzin nor bu des// mkhan chen 'jam dpal rdo rje'i bka' lung mchog /ldog par ma nus bris pa dge legs 'phel/ dpe gcig brgyud/ ༈ skyabs rje pad nor rin po che'i phyag bris las zhal bshus pa dge//
